status: Prospective initial plan, written before candidate comparison scores; October-November already inspected development evidence
target: Positive quantities with normalized Completed or Shipped statuses, after exact-row deduplication. Return flags on fulfilled rows retained as gross outbound; Returned status, nonpositive quantities, Processing and Cancelled excluded. No return credits without usable-restock timing.
missing_dates: Daily absent events become zero recorded units only within the supplied continuous transaction window, after each series first observed transaction; not proof of zero underlying demand or store availability. All deployment series have established pre-development histories. No pre-first-observation zeros in training.
population: All 336 supplied product/store keys, identical for every candidate, without filtering on evaluation outcomes
information_boundary: Only transactions dated on/before each origin; present-day final statuses have unknown change times, limiting historical realism. Operating policies used only for horizon lengths, not historical inventory scoring.
training: History through origin; ridge weekly labels end on/before origin, trailing two years, with features requiring 364 days of prior series history
evaluation: Oct 6-Nov 30 2025 for seven-day targets; coverage targets only when their full 8-14-day horizon ends by November 30, thus first seven origins
horizons: Primary next seven days; secondary row-specific supplier lead plus seven review days. Daily constant rate extrapolation for each method. No December scoring.
baseline: Previous complete calendar month's recorded daily mean, scaled to horizon; analytical baseline, not proven incumbent formula

candidates.pooled90: 50% local 90-day rate and 50% independence product/store pooled rate
candidates.ridge: Pooled ridge alpha=10, standardized ten features: intercept, recent 7/28/91/364-day weekly rates, same week prior year, annual sine/cosine, annual seasonal interactions with long rate; nonnegative clipped predictions. Fixed configuration, no search.

primary: Mean absolute error in units per product at a store per seven-day forecast; equal weights over 336 keys and eight origins
selection: Lowest pooled primary MAE; if within 1e-9 choose baseline then recent90 then pooled90 then ridge. No invented meaningful-gain threshold. Freeze selected method for routine.
secondary: recorded-target sensitivity excluding all return flags and including positive Processing
timing-shortage flags and order sensitivity to alternative candidate rates
limits: No historical stock, lost sales, purchase prices, cost function or independent success threshold; no business-cost scoring. No independent success gate can be closed. No revisions or additional searches planned.
